output.brief: The Kestria buffering problem comes from the new smart-TV app version 5.2, not from the CDN switch. Version 5.2 shortened the video buffer settings. It went live in Kestria as the canary market on 9 Oct, the same day as the CDN cutover, which is why the two were confused. On the same new CDN, smart-TV 5.2 stalls about 5.9% of viewing time, while every other client stays at 0.6–0.7%. That holds across all three ISPs. Employee TVs on the old CDN showed the same regression (5.7% vs 0.6%) before launch. Handball viewing and ISP congestion don't fit the pattern. Recommended next steps: (1) Revert the abr_v2 remote-config for Kestria to the 5.1 settings. It takes about an hour and needs no new build. (2) Hold the 20 Nov all-market rollout until it's fixed. (3) Don't send the SLA notice, withhold fees or move traffic back, because that would punish the wrong party and fix nothing. (4) Keep the alert on. (5) Hold off on the cancellation offer. The price rise on 1 Oct also contributes to cancellations, and that share is unmeasured. (6) Add app version and device to the dashboard when the Q1 pipeline rebuild lands. Confidence is high.
